verdicts.title: Galois Self-Dual Constacyclic Codes
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Generalizing Euclidean inner product and Hermitian inner product, we introduce Galois inner products, and study the Galois self-dual constacyclic codes in a very general setting by a uniform method. The conditions for existence of Galois self-dual and isometrically Galois self-dual constacyclic codes are obtained. As consequences, the results on self-dual, iso-dual and Hermitian self-dual constacyclic codes are derived.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses Galois self-dual constacyclic codes and existence conditions via inner products, with no mention of SAT, clause subsets, or entropy correlations as required by the conjecture.

verdicts.title: Optimum Subcodes of Self-Dual Codes and Their Optimum Distance Profiles
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Binary optimal codes often contain optimal or near-optimal subcodes. In this paper we show that this is true for the family of self-dual codes. One approach is to compute the optimum distance profiles (ODPs) of linear codes, which was introduced by Luo, et. al. (2010).
